{{Quote|I remember. My brother died in the conflict. His ship came out of hyperspace in the center of a sun.|Armand Isard remembers his brother and the ships fate|<ref name="AotE1">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref>}}
The [[Armand Isard's brother|brother]] of the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] served aboard a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] '''starship''' during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]<ref name="AotE1" /> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="shw" /> During the war, the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] was one of those infected by the [[navcomputer virus]] released by the [[Stark Commercial Combine]] against the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. The virus caused the ship to exit [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] in the center of a [[Star/Legends|star]] while it was en route to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]], killing Isard's brother and destroying the vessel. Isard would remember the ship's destruction in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] when discussing the War with [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Jahan Cross]].<ref name="AotE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The starship was first shown in a flashback in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]], which was written by [[John Ostrander]] as part of the "[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse|Iron Eclipse]]" story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire]]'' series.
